methodologyNotes: Covers variable-power riflescopes (telescopic rifle sights) sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes fixed-power scopes, red-dot and holographic sights, prism scopes, spotting scopes, and clip-on night-vision/thermal devices. Price is US MSRP (or typical street price where MSRP is not published) in USD. magnificationRange is the optical zoom span written as 'low-highx' (e.g. '5-25x'), unitless. objectiveDiameterMm is the front (objective) lens diameter in millimeters. tubeDiameterMm is the main-tube diameter in millimeters (25.4 = 1 inch, 30, 34, or 35). focalPlane is an enum: 'FFP' (first focal plane) or 'SFP' (second focal plane). reticleIlluminated is a boolean: true if the reticle has powered illumination. elevationTravelMil is total internal elevation adjustment range in milliradians (MIL/MRAD); scopes specced in MOA are converted at 1 MIL = 3.438 MOA. clickValue is the published turret adjustment increment as a string carrying its unit (e.g. '0.1 MRAD' or '0.25 MOA'). fieldOfViewFt is the field of view in feet at 100 yards, measured at the lowest (widest) magnification. eyeReliefIn is eye relief in inches (the nominal or range midpoint as published). parallaxType is an enum: 'fixed', 'adjustable-objective', or 'side-focus'. lengthIn is overall length in inches. weightOz is weight in ounces.
